text:
jess: Quick sync: handing off v2 rollout plan to runtime/SDK teams. Target staged traffic shift Mon Apr 6 (UTC). Need SDK stable release by Fri Apr 3 EOD. Who's owning runtime infra, SDK patch, and regression evals?

omar: I can take runtime infra for the staged shift. I'll coordinate autoscaler and routing policies. @sasha will you own model-variant fallback mapping?

sasha: Yep, I'll own fallback mapping. Need clarity on which old endpoints remain for 30 days vs full deprecation.

jess: Plan: 30-day soft-deprec for v1 read-only paths, immediate 403 for write-only endpoints after canary if incompatible. I'll post full timeline doc later.

maria: SDK: we have a small breaking change in header format. PR open: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/1298 — aiming for green CI by Thu. Need runtime to accept both formats for 2 weeks.

kevin: I'll add temporary header parsing to runtime; any test vectors? can we get sample requests?

sasha: Sample payloads below:
```json
{"model": "redwood-3b", "input": "hi"}
```
Also for kv-cache cookie header: `x-rw-kv: v2`

anya: I'll run the eval suite on canary after SDK release. ETA Tue Apr 7. Need a stable set of prompt tests (I'll pull from /evals/migration) — @maria can you tag the prompts?

maria: Tagged a subset in the PR (migration-tests/*). Also added expected token distribution snapshots.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary started on runtime-v2-2026-04-06-0 at 2026-04-06T02:10Z :rocket:

omar: Canary looks healthy so far. Latency + p99 within SLO. One 503 spike at 02:28 related to batch worker; investigating.

jess: If 503 persists, rollback plan is to reroute traffic to v1 pool and revert header parsing change. @kevin can you prepare the revert PR and a one-command rollback?

kevin: On it — I'll have a rollback playbook and a small script: `scripts/rollback_canary.sh` in the runtime repo.

ci-bot: CI: sdk#1298 — tests: 112 passed, 3 flaky skipped. Coverage: 98.1%.

anya: Noting data-sensitivity: private deployments will need a patch window; reaching out to enterprise success to schedule maintenance.

sasha: Owner matrix: runtime=omar, fallback=sasha, sdk=maria, evals=anya, rollout=jess. Adding this to the migration doc.

jess: Perfect. Final asks: (1) SDK green by Thu EOD, (2) runtime accepts both header formats for 14 days, (3) evals on canary within 48h of canary start. Ping here with blockers.
